request: Unify source SEO URL signals to the www domain
title: Canonicalize site URL to www domain
purpose: Align SEO source of truth with the live redirected www domain for canonical, sitemap, robots, OpenGraph, and structured data URLs

files.purpose: Change the shared public site URL fallback to the live www domain so generated canonical, sitemap, robots, OpenGraph, Twitter, and JSON-LD URLs are consistent with the deployed redirect target.
files.previous_behavior: When NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL was not provided, SEO helpers generated non-www URLs even though the live site redirects to https://www.boryoung.co.kr.
files.new_behavior: When NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL is not provided, SEO helpers generate https://www.boryoung.co.kr URLs, matching the live canonical host expected by crawlers.
files.data_impact: none: this is a source configuration constant change only and does not read, write, migrate, or delete operational data.
files.access_control_impact: none: no authentication, authorization, roles, permissions, or protected-route behavior changed.
risks: If production sets NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to the old non-www value, the environment variable will override this fallback and must be updated separately.
Search engines may need time to recrawl the updated canonical and sitemap URLs after deployment.
files.rollback: Restore apps/web/src/lib/seo.ts from baseline commit f9af93bd14e4c91eab07b290cc0a2dede3a16b5e with git restore --source f9af93bd14e4c91eab07b290cc0a2dede3a16b5e -- apps/web/src/lib/seo.ts, or change the SITE_URL fallback back to https://boryoung.co.kr. No data migration rollback applies.

production_safety.operational_data: No production data was read, created, updated, or deleted. The change is limited to a repository SEO URL constant.
production_safety.schema_migration: none: no database schema, migration, seed contract, API contract, or storage format changed.
external_side_effects: none: no deploy, crawl request, external API call, notification, or production system update was performed.

verification.command: rg -n "https://boryoung\.co\.kr|https://www\.boryoung\.co\.kr|NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL" src\lib\seo.ts src\app\robots.ts src\app\sitemap.ts src\app\layout.tsx src\app\page.tsx -S
verification.evidence: The shared SITE_URL fallback now points to https://www.boryoung.co.kr, and SEO route files consume SITE_URL instead of hardcoded non-www URLs.
apps/web TypeScript completed with tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit.

residual_risks: Production deployment may still need NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL updated to https://www.boryoung.co.kr if the hosting environment defines it.
Naver Search Advisor still needs the www property and sitemap submitted after deployment for fastest recrawl.
